fusions.name: Ringing Ears
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles. Each has a 35% chance to be confused for 3 seconds and attack its own side.

fusions.name: Kick When Down
fusions.desc: A cheap kick usable only on a target at or below 30% health. It deals 24 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Feint and Wind Up
fusions.desc: You sidestep 2 tiles, and your critical hits deal 40% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Set Up the Patsy
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
